# new-line-at-eof

Require or disallow a line break at the end of the file.

| Category | Recommended | Safe autofix | Default options |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| formatting | no | yes | `"yes"` |

Requires (`"yes"`) or forbids (`"no"`) a final line break, with a safe fix.

## Configuration

```json
{ "rules": { "new-line-at-eof": ["error", "yes"] } }
```

## Triggered by
